scope: Task summaries and persistent pending actions
Compatible shared forms with partial-failure retry
Persistent artifact versions, comparison and actual parent-version sources
Article and plan editing with renewed preview, review and confirmation
Desktop resizing and mobile artifact preview

antd.warning: CLI flags Drawer.width; the installed Ant Design 5.29.3 types support it

limitations: Backend business writes use real services with H2 and scripted model responses
Paid-model quality, actual MySQL, real process restart and rollout remain S5 work
Editable content is limited to article drafts and plan chapters
Artifact snapshots do not follow later edits on business pages
Unsaved editor content is memory-only and is lost on page refresh
Source labels contain only actual task requirements and upstream artifact versions
